values.note: $25 camping fee plus $8 a night for electric (every drive-in site has it); the South walk-in tent sites are $25. Cancelling at least 7 days out forfeits the $8 reservation fee and an $8 cancellation fee.

values.note: North campground 54 electric sites (1-51 less 38, two accessible sites booked by phone, A-D); South campground 7 electric sites on the engine (53-58, 62; its map numbers electric sites 52-64) and 3 walk-in tent sites (65-67).

values.note: Reservations close 7 days before arrival; inside that, open sites are taken by registering in person at the campground on the day. Reserved stays run 2 to 14 nights, 3 on the Memorial Day, July 4 and Labor Day weekends; from June 1 to Labor Day no more than 14 days in any four weeks. The accessible sites are booked by phone with the parks office.

booking.source: https://reservations.co.portage.wi.gov/parks/camping/lake_emily_park_north_campground/ ('NO RESERVATIONS ALLOWED LESS THAN 7 DAYS IN ADVANCE. YOU MUST SAME DAY REGISTER ON THE DAY YOU WANT TO START CAMPING, IN-PERSON AT EACH CAMPGROUND FOR ANY OPEN SITE.'); policy PDF ('Reservations will be accepted for a minimum of two consecutive days and a maximum of 14 days. There is a 3 night minimum stay requirement for holiday weekends Memorial Day, 4th of July, and Labor Day.'; 'no camping unit shall remain for a period greater than 14 days, in any four-week period from June 1st to Labor Day'), read 2026-11-16

note: Portage County park on 96-acre Lake Emily west of Amherst Junction, in two campgrounds: North, a large loop of sites in pine woods north of Park Drive, and South, a small wooded loop on the lake's south shore off Lake Drive beside the Tomorrow River State Trail. Boat ramp, swimming beach, two picnic lodges and a ball field. --Claude
summary: County page, Konect reservation engine (2027 search), policy PDF and both campground maps read: $25 + $8 electric = $33 (fees new) with $8 reservation fee; 64 sites (North 54 electric, South 7 electric + 3 walk-in tent); season May 1-Oct 31 confirmed; operator engine, 7-day cutoff then same-day walk-up (fcfs after_cutoff confirmed), 2-14 night reservations, 3 on holidays. Not waterfront kept.
flags: TWO CAMPGROUNDS, under the split distance: North (centre ~44.4740,-89.3299, off Park Dr / Old Hwy 18, 54 sites, https://reservations.co.portage.wi.gov/parks/camping/lake_emily_park_north_campground/) and South (centre ~44.4679,-89.3303 on the south shore, its loop reached from Lake Dr off Lake Emily Rd, 10 sites, https://reservations.co.portage.wi.gov/parks/camping/lake_emily_park_south_campground/). About 650 m apart across the lake, with separate entrances - below the ~1 km line, so one entry; noted for the reviewer.
